collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: Collections group related titles, such as a film series. You only see the titles you are allowed to see.
collections.deletePrompt: The collection is deleted; its titles stay in the library.
collections.nfoLinked: Also holds every title whose NFO collection is “{name}”.
collections.noMembers: This collection has no titles you can see.
collections.addHint: Open a title and use “Add to a list” to add it.
collections.truncated: Only the first 2000 titles are listed.

form.name: Name
form.nfoNameHint: Titles whose NFO <set> or <collection> carries this name join automatically.

lists.title: Playlists
lists.intro: Your playlists, and playlists other users made public. Only the titles you are allowed to see are listed; watching happens in the apps.
lists.deletePrompt: The playlist is deleted for everyone; its titles stay in the library.
lists.noEntries: This playlist has no titles you can see.
lists.addHint: Open a title and use “Add to a list” to add it.

form.name: Name
form.publicHint: Other users can see this playlist, each only with the titles they may see. Only you can change it.
